json.justification: The photos are distant, low-resolution security-camera frames taken during installation, not proper survey shots. The panel appears to be a clean, modern gray outdoor enclosure with no visible rust, but no brand label, breaker text, or ON/OFF markings can be read, even with the door open (Photos 2, 3, 13). Without a legible brand or confirmable breaker orientation, a person should verify.
